en.bdb: Holy congregation liberates even the knaves

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਣ ਵਣ ਵਾੜੀ ਖੇਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਜਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: san van vaaRee khet ik paraupakaar vikaar janaavai|

en.bdb: Hemp and cotton grow in the same field but the use of one is benevolent while the other one is put to evil use.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਲ ਕਢਾਹਿ ਵਟਾਇ ਸਣ ਰਸਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਨ੍ਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: khal kaddaeh vaTai san rasaa ba(n)dhan hoi banhaavai|

en.bdb: After peeling off the hemp plant rope is made whose nooses are used to tie people in bondage.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਸਾ ਮਲਮਲ ਸਿਰੀਸਾਫੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਕਤਾਇ ਕਪਾਹ ਵੁਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: khaasaa malamal sireesaaf soot katai kapaeh vunaavai|

en.bdb: On the other hand, from cotton are made coarse cloth muslin and sirisaf.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਜਣੁ ਕਜਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਧੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: lajan kajan hoi kai saadh asaadh biradh biradhaavai|

en.bdb: Cotton in the form of cloth covers the modesty of others and protects the dharma of sadhus as well as wicked persons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਨ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)g dhokh niradhokh mokh sa(n)g subhaau na saadh miTaavai|

en.bdb: The sadhus even when they associate with the evil never repudiate their saintly nature.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਪੜੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਗ ਧੂੜਿ ਧੁਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: trapaR hovai dharamasaal saadhasa(n)gat pag dhooR dhumaavai|

en.bdb: When the hemp transformed into coarse cloth is brought to the holy places for spreading in the holy congregation, it also becomes blest after coming in touch with the dust of the feet of the sadhus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਸਣ ਕਿਰਤਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: kuT kuT san kirataas kar har jas likh puraan sunaavai|

en.bdb: Also, when after getting a thorough beating paper is made of it, the holy men write praises of the Lord.on it and recite the same for others.
The holy congregation makes the fallen ones also  holy.
